mapper.select: SELECT r.ROOM_NAME room_name, r.PRICE price, r.DISCOUNT_PRICE discount_price, r.CHECK_IN check_in, r.CHECK_OUT check_out, ri.CAPACITY_INFO capacity_info, rim.IMG_NAME room_img_name, a.acm_name acm_name FROM ROOM r JOIN ROOM_INFO ri ON r.ROOM_ID = ri.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM_IMG rim ON r.ROOM_ID = rim.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ACCOMMODATION a ON a.acm_id = r.acm_id WHERE r.ROOM_ID = #{room_id} AND (rim.ROOM_IMG_NO = 1 OR rim.ROOM_IMG_NO IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION(RSR_NAME, RSR_PHONE_NUMBER, CHECK_IN_DATE, CHECK_OUT_DATE, NUMBER_PEOPLE, RSR_STATUS, USER_ID, ROOM_ID) VALUES(#{rsr_name},#{rsr_phone_number},#{check_in_date},#{check_out_date},#{number_people},'결제완료',#{user_id},#{room_id})
